mainEntity.name: What is Payday Super and when does it start?

acceptedAnswer.text: From 1 July 2026, under 'Payday Super', employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions alongside each payday — with contributions required to reach the employee's fund within 7 business days. Late payment triggers the Super Guarantee Charge and ATO scrutiny. Our matched firms implement Payday Super-compliant payroll so you meet the deadline each pay cycle.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I get contractor classification wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Misclassifying an employee as a contractor can trigger back-paid PAYG, super guarantee, leave entitlements, and penalties — potentially years of exposure. The ATO and Fair Work use specific tests (not just the contract). The matched firm assesses your arrangements and confirms the correct classification, or restructures the engagement.

mainEntity.name: Do I need STP2 even for one or two employees?

acceptedAnswer.text: STP2 is mandatory for almost all employers regardless of headcount — there are very limited exemptions. If you pay wages, you almost certainly need STP2 reporting each pay run. The matched bookkeeper or accountant sets this up in your payroll software and keeps it compliant.

mainEntity.name: How much does payroll compliance support cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ongoing payroll processing is typically $200–$600 per month depending on headcount and complexity. Setup and compliance reviews are usually quoted as a fixed fee. The matched firm gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation — the matching is free.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched payroll specialist contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your payroll needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a payroll specialist help with salary packaging and FBT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched firm advises on salary packaging structures, FBT implications, and reportable fringe benefits — ensuring your arrangements are compliant and tax-effective for both employer and employee.

Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Can a payroll specialist help with year-end payment summaries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched firm reconciles year-end payment summaries, ensures STP2 finalisation declarations are lodged correctly, and manages any adjustments — so your employees' income statements are accurate and ready for their tax returns.

blocks.heading: Payroll & Compliance — what we can help with
blocks.text: SPECIALIST NETWORKPayroll & Compliance — what we can help withSuper guarantee and the 'Payday Super' shiftFrom 1 July 2026, under 'Payday Super', employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions alongside each payday — with contributions required to reach the employee's fund within 7 business days. Missing the deadline triggers the Super Guarantee Charge, employee complaints, and ATO scrutiny. Our matched firms implement Payday Super reporting and ensure contributions are calculated and paid correctly — before the deadline becomes a problem.Single Touch Reporting (STP2)STP2 is mandatory for most employers and requires payroll data to be reported to the ATO each pay run. The data must be accurate, timely, and correctly coded — errors create reconciliation problems at year-end. Our matched bookkeepers and accountants set up STP2 correctly in your payroll software and keep it compliant each pay cycle.Contractor vs employee — the grey zoneMisclassifying a worker as a contractor when they are legally an employee triggers back-paid super, PAYG, and penalties — sometimes years later. With the $190,100 high-income contractor threshold under Fair Work's Closing Loopholes legislation and the ATO's own contractor tests for super and PAYG purposes, getting classification right is essential. Our matched firms assess your arrangements and recommend the correct structure.
